sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual airborne microbial sample record.

city_name.descr: Name of the city where the sample was collected.

country_name.descr: Name of the country where the sample was collected.

collection_datetime.descr: Date and time when the sample was collected, ideally in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2026-08-18T14:30:00Z).

time_of_day.descr: Categorical time period at sampling, such as morning, afternoon, evening, or night.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Sampling site elevation above sea level in meters.

air_quality_index.descr: Air Quality Index measured or obtained for the sampling location and time; specify the index standard used if possible.

pm25_ug_m3.descr: Particulate matter concentration for PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic meter.

pm10_ug_m3.descr: Particulate matter concentration for PM10 in micrograms per cubic meter.

pollution_level.descr: Categorical pollution level classification at the time of sampling, such as low, moderate, high, or very high.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at sampling in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_pct.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time as a percentage.

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling in meters per second.

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction in degrees from north (0–360).

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation during or immediately preceding sampling, in millimeters.

weather_condition.descr: General weather condition at sampling, such as clear, cloudy, rainy, foggy, or snowy.

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect airborne microbial material, such as filter-based air sampling, impaction, or liquid impingement.

air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled, in cubic meters.

sample_height_m.descr: Height above ground at which the sampler inlet was positioned, in meters.

surrounding_land_use.descr: Dominant surrounding land use category near the sampling site, such as residential, commercial, industrial, park, or mixed-use.

distance_to_industrial_area_m.descr: Approximate distance from the sampling location to the nearest industrial area, in meters.

distance_to_green_space_m.descr: Approximate distance from the sampling location to the nearest green space, in meters.

near_traffic_corridor.descr: Whether the sampling site is near a major road, highway, or other high-traffic corridor.

near_water_body.descr: Whether the sampling site is near a river, lake, sea, or other water body.

urban_density_category.descr: Categorical description of urban density around the site, such as low, medium, or high.

site_description.descr: Free-text description of the sampling site and immediate surroundings.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used to generate the genomic data, such as Illumina, Oxford Nanopore, or PacBio.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation protocol used prior to sequencing.

target_region.descr: Genomic target sequenced, such as 16S rRNA, ITS, shotgun metagenomics, or other marker regions.

read_length_bp.descr: Typical read length in base pairs for the sequencing data.

raw_data_accession.descr: Repository accession or identifier for the raw sequencing data.
